entities.name: Marko Pešić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marko Pešić is a German and Serbian professional basketball executive and former player, currently serving as the general manager in the Bayern Munich of the Basketball Bundesliga. He represented Germany internationally. His father is a Serbian basketball coach and former player Svetislav Pešić.
